<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def parse_track(ascii_lines, row_idx):
    row = ascii_lines[row_idx]
    blocks = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(row):
        c = row[i]
        if c not in 'cRNG':
            block_color = c
            j = i
            while j < len(row) and row[j] == block_color:
                j += 1
            blocks.append((block_color, i, j-i))
            i = j
        else:
            i += 1
    return blocks

# Click middle green shifter to probe its effect
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 26, 'col': 47}])

# Check what changed
ascii_after = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
ascii_before = last_transition.before_frame.ascii.split('\n')

print("After middle green click:")

print("Middle:", [c for c, col, w in parse_track(ascii_after, 26)])
print("Bottom:", [c for c, col, w in parse_track(ascii_after, 35)])
print("Row 44:", [c for c, col, w in parse_track(ascii_after, 44)])

print("\nBefore middle green click:")

print("Middle:", [c for c, col, w in parse_track(ascii_before, 26)])
print("Bottom:", [c for c, col, w in parse_track(ascii_before, 35)])

    row = ascii_lines[row_idx]
    blocks = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(row):
        c = row[i]
